//: The KitnaPay mark: three speed lines, a navy K and a coral P leaning into them.
Fitted to cubic Beziers from the supplied logo image; it is an approximation of
that artwork, not a copy of a vector, so expect to refine it against the original.
This file is the ONE drawing of the mark. BrandMark.tsx renders it in the app,
web/src/components/brand/BrandMark.tsx renders the same JSON in the browser, and
scripts/generate-brand-assets.js renders every PNG in assets/ and store-listing/
from it, so the in-app logo, the launcher icon and the store page cannot drift.
Units: the mark is 1000 wide with its origin at its own top-left corner. Each part
carries the box it occupies, so it can be drawn and animated as its own layer, and
the parts are drawn in the order they appear here - the P paints over the tip of
the K's arm, which is what makes the two letters interlock.
Every edge leans at the same angle. The geometry was built upright and sheared by
0.26 of its height, so a change of angle is one number re-applied, not forty points
re-derived.
navy and coral are the two brand colours, and theme/index.ts reads both as
colors.primary and colors.accent - the UI and the mark beside it cannot drift apart.
A path with no paint is filled with navy; a paint names a gradient in paints.
splashMarkWidth is the mark's width in dp on the launch splash. The system splash
shows adaptive-icon.png (mark 544 of 1024) at app.json's imageWidth of 288dp, so the
mark is 288 * 544 / 1024 = 153dp there, and AnimatedSplash draws it at the same width
so the hand-over does not jump. generate-brand-assets.js throws if the three disagree.
